messages:
maria: Heads up — SCIM provisioning spiked errors ~09:12 UTC. Lots of 400/422s from the provisioner. Logs show 'failed to decrypt attribute value' when processing group membership updates.

alex: saw this too, alerting oncall. Is this tied to yesterday's KMS alias rotation?

jordan: likely. I can see failed KMS decrypts in the provisioner pod: 
```
2026-03-21T09:12:04Z ERR scim-provisioner failed to decrypt extId: DecryptionFailure: key not found
```

sam: tagging: @security-oncall @riley. Any risk indicators (exfil, mass-deprovision)?

riley: quick check of audit logs — no mass deprovs yet. We have many pending failures so groups aren't updating. No sign of deleted user events.

maria: Stack: SCIM queue items are piling. This is causing some teams to not get RBAC changes applied. Can we pause consumer retries to avoid accidental deprovs when fix lands?

alex: good call. I'm pausing retries at the consumer level: `kubectl exec -it scim-consumer -- env SCIM_RETRY=0` — pausing now.

devops-bot: deploy-scim-consumer pause completed (runbook:scim/kms-rotation) :white_check_mark:

jordan: root cause summary so far: KMS key alias was rotated & old key removed from the IAM role before we rewrapped the encrypted attributes in the DB. SCIM attributes use JWE-ish envelope in our DB for extId/nameid. Provisioner tries KMS decrypt, fails.

maria: confirming — which alias was removed? Who rotated?

alex: looks like `alias/scim-wrap-key` was rotated by infra-deploy during automated rotation at 02:00 UTC. The new key is there, but rewrap job didn't run because the scheduled job errored (timeout).

sam: from a threat perspective — any possibility attacker compromised rotation process?

security-oncall: low likelihood. No unusual principal activity around rotation. Rotation triggered by our scheduled job with the infra-service account. We'll still run a forensics snippet: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/scim-wrap-key`

riley: audit logs: rotation event shows infra-deploy executed rotateKey, followed by a failed migrate job: `scim-rewrap-job` at 02:05 -> timeout. No external principals.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) re-enable the old key alias mapping temporarily (if possible) so decrypts succeed, OR 2) re-run the rewrap job to encrypt DB attributes with the new key. Which is safer?

alex: option 2 is preferred (no alias rollback). But rewrap job must be run carefully — it will touch many rows. We'll run a canary subset, then full backfill.

jordan: I'll run a dry-run canary: `scim-rewrap --dry-run --limit 100 --filter=org:staging` then verify provisioning to staging teams.

maria: also add quick guard in provisioner to surface clear error code and stop attempts to deprovision on decrypt failure (current behavior is ambiguous).

sam: important: update RBAC audit to flag any pending deprovision that was suppressed during the pause so we can coordinate replays.

devops-bot: job scim-rewrap (dry-run) queued on batch cluster id b-1234.

riley: after dry-run succeeds, schedule full rewrap with maintenance window and notify impacted teams. We should also add a temporary fallback to try previous key via alias history if decrypt fails (but only for 1 hour).

security-oncall: thanks. I'll also run a vulnerability triage: ensure no sensitive attribute plaintext leaked to logs during errors. Maria — can you grep for `scim-provisioner.*extId` in logs?

maria: grepping now — errors only log extId masked (last 4 chars), no full PII. Example: `failed to decrypt extId=xxxx-12ab`

alex: timeline + next steps: 09:16 dry-run kicked off; 09:30 verify staging; 10:00 schedule full rewrap and notify product + CSMs; pause consumer retries remains until rewrap completes.

jordan: dry-run finished — 100 rows rewrapped, provisioning to staging succeeded. No RBAC mismatches.

maria: launching full rewrap now with rate limit and parallelism=4. Notifying #customer-alerts draft.

devops-bot: scim-rewrap job started (job id b-1234-2). ETA ~45m.

sam: after rewrap completes, remember: run `scim-queue replay --since 09:00 --safeguard=simulate` to replay suppressed updates and confirm idempotency.

riley: note for postmortem: add a CI check that blocks alias rotation until `scim-rewrap` run completes successfully or a rollback path is in place.

security-oncall: closing immediate risk: low (no exfil). Action items assigned: alex run rewrap (in progress), jordan validate, maria verify logs, riley update runbook. We'll schedule a 1pm postmortem.

maria: thanks team — will post a short incident summary to #incidents after full rewrap completes. :thumbsup:
